records.summary: Rechecked Binance's official PoR milestone and found the 12-hour snapshot target elapsed at 07:33 UTC while public results remained unavailable at 11:07 UTC; Binance states results by November 2 and its verified account lists phased withdrawal restoration for November 1 at 05:33 UTC. CoinDesk's reserve review identifies Binance14/16 Ethereum wallets in the October 1 PoR set and estimates ETH backing near 94%, but does not crosswalk the five XRPL source wallets. Captured TradRadar derivatives and Alpha Finance ETF flows with exact cutoffs and limitations. Audited 183 open PRs and current main's Cross Analysis, Scheduler Tick and Databricks token mutation paths. Audited entity sentiment semantics and corrected a baseline chronology leakage gap in PR #1410; exact-head CI passed 375 tests plus 8 subtests and the fail-closed gate passed. All fixes remain draft/unmerged; no market features admitted and no forecast issued.
